pages.title: The path
pages.text: The closest star system to the Sun. After the $(l:space/planets/kuiper_belt)Kuiper Belt$(), the target is Proxima B. Find it with a telescope from the edge of the system: $(l:space/planets/pluto)Pluto$(), $(l:space/planets/haumea)Haumea$() or the Kuiper Belt. It takes a tier 5 rocket and so the $(l:space/tech/high_rockets#advanced_pad)5x5 advanced pad$().

pages.title: Proxima B
pages.text: It has gold, tin, copper, coal, silicon and diamonds, plus mushroom geysers. Proxima C and D are enabled on the map. Home is far away, so bring a 5x5 pad, a fuel loader and canisters.
